cw_marquee_intern.text: Welcome to the Vane Estates Premium Experience. Please do not touch the brochures. They are not finished, and neither is the lease.
We plan an Advanced Causeway Tier. Hexagonal flats, hexagonal cafe, and a hexagonal plate for each visitor.
The real columns are a World Heritage Site, as it happens. Somebody has to tell Lord Vane. It will not be me.

then.text: My sack trolley? Aye, it went out Tuesday teatime. Signed for by Mrs Crozier. Came back Wednesday with grit in the wheels, and I'm not paying for the cleaning of it.
Do you know she asked me to make a cloth for 'Table 1' long enough to hide a pig? A pig! Weddings, I tell you.

else.text: Seamus Hanlon, canapes and consequences. If it's not in a vol-au-vent I don't know about it.

then.text: A missing stone? Heavens. At the Causeway? Isn't that terrible. Terrible. I'm very busy, I have a wedding on Saturday.
No, I haven't seen it. And no, I have nothing under any tablecloths. Why would you look at the tablecloths? Stop looking at the tablecloths.

else.text: Fidelma Crozier, Events. Vane Estates. Weddings, conferences, bat mitzvahs, one memorable dog christening.
